text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation in this space. The glass-walled meeting room filled with people engaged in discussion or learning signals collaborative thought, knowledge, and possibility. Stepping closer to the R+D exhibit, I am drawn deeper into reflection. The colorful displays and interactive screens celebrate research, development, and progress—concepts that stir in me a blend of wonder and critical inquiry. Amid innovation and collective intellect, I ponder both the promise and the complexity of advancing human knowledge in community.
